title_en: The Religious Authority Must Be a Mujtahid in Quranic Exegesis (Part 1)
description_en: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari (may his shadow endure) holds that a religious authority must be a complete mujtahid in Quranic exegesis, not merely regarding verses of legal rulings, otherwise he is not truly a mujtahid.
summary: Discusses the necessity of comprehensive expertise in Quranic exegesis for anyone claiming the rank of a mujtahid or religious authority.
